segments.name: Net lease real estate
segments.description: Acquires, owns and actively manages freestanding commercial properties leased under long-term net lease agreements to diversified operators in the U.S. and Europe.
segments.evidence: Our primary business is the acquisition, ownership, and active management of freestanding commercial properties leased under long‑term net lease agreements to a diversified base of operators, including a blend of investment grade, investment grade equivalent, and other creditworthy clients.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay contractually defined rental payments under long-term net leases, with clients responsible for most property-level operating expenses.
revenueModel.evidence: Under a net lease structure, clients are typically responsible for most or all property-level operating expenses, including real estate taxes, insurance, and maintenance, while we are entitled to receive contractually defined rental payments, many of which include embedded contractual rent escalations.
